narrative:
The balance sheet carries an unhedged 0-3M repricing gap of about PLN 6.4B. Variable-rate mortgages, SME loans and the NBP-bill liquidity portfolio reprice faster than behavioural deposits, which is why NII falls when the NBP cuts.

An existing PLN 4.2B receive-fixed IRS overlay already shifts part of that exposure into the 2-5Y bucket. Extending it at today's ~4.05% swap rate locks in carry before further cuts are priced in.

Constraints: the ΔEVE supervisory outlier test (15% of Tier 1) and ΔNII limits under IRRBB. Ex-Citi term deposits rolling off in Q1-27 also shorten liability duration in the 3-12M bucket.

signals.title: EBA IRRBB Supervisory Outlier Test
signals.excerpt: Banks must report ΔNII and ΔEVE under prescribed rate shocks; a ΔEVE decline above 15% of Tier 1 capital triggers supervisory dialogue.

signals.title: NBP Monetary Policy Council — Rate Decision
signals.excerpt: The MPC lowered the reference rate and signalled further easing as CPI returns toward the 2.5% target. Market pricing implies a terminal rate near 3.50%.

signals.title: Citi Handlowy Retail Integration Completed
signals.excerpt: Migration of the Citi Handlowy retail business completed on 15 June 2026: PLN 22.1B of deposits, PLN 6B of loans, PLN 8.9B AuM and ~1,600 employees now on VeloBank systems.
